insider_note: A definition question with a list attached. Name at least three groups of organisms.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Microbiology defined
steps.margin_note: Definition with the size criterion in it. Three lines.
lines: MICROBIOLOGY is the branch of biological science
that deals with MICRO ORGANISMS — organisms too
small to be seen with the unaided eye.
steps.why: The subject is defined by the size of what it studies rather than by any one group, which is why it covers organisms as different as bacteria and protozoans.
common_mistakes: Saying microbiology is the study of bacteria only. It covers viruses and protozoans too.
Leaving out the size. Being too small to see is what puts an organism in this subject.
steps.memory_tip: One subject, defined by size and not by group.

steps.label: What it covers
steps.margin_note: Name the groups, then the founders. Four lines.

lines.text: Bacteria, viruses, fungi, algae and protozoans

lines: It includes the study of BACTERIA, VIRUSES,
Louis Pasteur and Robert Koch are regarded as
steps.why: The groups listed have nothing in common but their size, which is exactly the point the definition already made.
common_mistakes: Naming one group. The list is the second mark.
Naming the founders but leaving out the groups. The groups are what this part of the answer asks for; Pasteur and Koch are a useful extra line.
steps.memory_tip: Nothing in common but being small.
